abstract: A caller posing as the bank's security central warns the client their card was cloned and used for high-value purchases, then walks them through 'securing' the account via a transfer/Pix or confirming data.
safe_verification_channel: hang up and call the bank on the number on the card; banks never ask for a Pix transfer to 'secure' your account

abstract: Posing as a service/support, the scammer gets the victim's WhatsApp verification code to take over the account, then messages the victim's contacts from the cloned account asking for urgent Pix deposits.
safe_verification_channel: never share your WhatsApp code; enable two-step verification; confirm money requests by calling the contact

abstract: A caller claims to have kidnapped a relative, keeps the victim on the line with screams/threats to prevent verification, and demands an immediate transfer/Pix as ransom.
safe_verification_channel: hang up and call the relative directly; contact police 190 — real emergencies can be verified
red_flags: stay on the line / don't hang up
